verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom templates: you capture a machine and its configuration, then pick that template when creating new machines with your exact specifications. Full root access lets you build the environment before templating it. Deployments are documented as containers-as-a-service that run container images. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing your own arbitrary Docker image (Deployments are only framed as running container images for model serving, and no custom-container option is shown for Notebooks or Machines), detail on the template creation and update workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
